name: Shine N' Guard

features.text: Restores rubber, vinyl and plastic on both interior and exterior surfaces.
V.O.C. compliant and contains no solvents.

description: A lasting, high-gloss that creates a "like new" universal, water-based, silicone protectorant. This product has a long-lasting high gloss that gives a "like new" appearance. Shine n’ Guard ® protects, beautifies and restores tires, vinyl, rubber and leather.
application: Dilute up to 1 part product to 4 parts water depending on desired shine. • Tires: Evenly spray, brush or wipe on a clean, dry tire. Allow to set until product turns from a milky to clear, glossy appearance. • Vinyl, Rubber and Plastic: Apply product to surface with a clean towel or sponge. Allow to set and wipe away excess product. • Engines: Spray entire engine evenly. Wipe surfaces with a clean, soft cloth to remove excess product. Warning: Excess product should be wiped from tires to prevent "sling" and possible staining of adjacent painted-plastic surface from residue on the tires.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Gloss - 8 Durability - 4
